figures.caption: The continuum and centered shell branches along one momentum axis, with $m=1$, $h=1/12$. Marked points are integer torus modes; intermediate points use the real-symbol extension.
The centered three-mode packet at $m=1$, $h=1/12$ changes local density and spinor composition while keeping total squared norm one. The image evaluates the closed formula at finitely many times.
The proof separates the approximation of the initial field from the consistency estimate on finitely many modes. The diagram records the order of choices in the argument.
Fourier analysis and synthesis change the representation while preserving the Hilbert norm. The operator in each representation is related by conjugation.

Approximating a field in its Hilbert norm and approximating it together with its Hamiltonian image are different requirements. The plotted family is a bounded illustration of the graph-tail calculation.

The norm condition and the Hamiltonian-domain condition impose different decay requirements. The exact threshold argument uses the infinite series; finite plotted partial sums only illustrate its behavior.
